{{Quote|Here, take this sniper rifle. I need you to cover those troopers on the way in!|Ferroda, giving X2 a DC-15x|<ref name="Elite Squadron" />}}
The '''DC-15x sniper rifle''', also known as the '''DC-15x sniper blaster''', was a type of [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper blaster rifle]] used by [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sharpshooters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and later by [[clone stormtrooper]] [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The DC-15x was a modified version of the standard [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]].

==Description==
A modified version of the<ref name="BF1 guide" /> [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]],<ref name="RotS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> the DC-15x was a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper blaster rifle]] that fired narrow, high-intensity beams of [[Color/Legends|blue]] energy that were effective against [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Species/Legends|organics]] alike. The [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was equipped with a brown [[Stock/Legends|stock]] and a brown grip, an added [[Scope/Legends|scope]], and was given extra accuracy for long-range engagements.<ref name="BF1" /> It could fire up to six shots before having to be reloaded, and its scope only featured one magnification level.<ref name="BF2 Guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==History==
===The Clone Wars===
[[File:Sharpshooter.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A clone sniper wields a DC-15x during the First Battle of Geonosis.]]
The DC-15x sniper rifle was used extensively by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone snipers]], who trained exclusively with the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] prior to being deployed in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="BF1 guide" /> [[AT-RT driver]]s, who were specialized [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] that were trained to operate [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]], developed a familiarity with the DC-15x during their [[Scout/Legends|scout]] training, and frequently used the weapon during their missions.<ref name="SW:TOSaVC 30">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|30|Welcome On Board}}</ref> In addition, the weapon was also sometimes used by<ref name="BF1" /> [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captains]]<ref name="GG Captain">{{GentleGiantCite|set=Mini Busts|pack=Clone Trooper Captain|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/ggclonecaptain.asp}}</ref> in the first stages of the war,<ref name="BF2" /> and certain<ref name="BF2" /> [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]]<ref name="GAR Guide">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> and [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|clone airborne troopers]]<ref name="Hasbro Airborne">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#07: Airborne Trooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC07airborne.asp}}</ref> in the later stages of the war.<ref name="BF2" />

The DC-15x saw service from the conflict's very inception, including during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the [[First Battle of Kamino]], the [[Battle of Rhen Var (Clone Wars)|Battle of Rhen Var]], the [[Battle of Mygeeto]], the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]],<ref name="BF1" /> the [[Invasion of Tatooine]], and up until the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]], where it was used by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[X2]] as well.<ref name="Elite Squadron" /> [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] also utilized the DC-15x during the First Battle of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the [[Battle of Mygeeto]], the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]], the Battle of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], along with the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="BF2" />

===Imperial Era===
[[File:BF2_Kamino_5.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An anti-trooper wields a DC-15x sniper rifle against the 501st Legion, who had previously used the weapon during the Clone Wars.]]

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="III">{{Film|III}}</ref> some [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooters]] of the 501st carried the DC-15x sniper [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] into the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]].<ref name="BF2" /> Following the operation, the DC-15x was used by clone snipers against [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ferroda]], in the wake of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66's]] activation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Elite Squadron" />

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Elite Squadron" /> the DC-15x sniper rifle was used at some point between [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]<ref name="Dantooine Dating">The narration in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' video game states that fifteen years have elapsed between the [[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|battle on Dantooine]] and X2's first meeting with [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]. Their meeting occurs at a point between the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places those events in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], respectively. Using simple math to deduct fifteen years from the earliest possible date of the meeting and the latest one, the battle on Dantooine can be approximated to a time period between the years [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].</ref> by [[clone stormtrooper]] snipers, during the [[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|Battle of Dantooine]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="Elite Squadron" /> In [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the DC-15x saw use once again, now in the hands of the [[Kaminoan resistance]]'s [[anti-trooper]] snipers, who used the weapon against the Empire's 501st Legion throughout the [[Kamino uprising]].<ref name="BF2" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The DC-15x sniper rifle first appeared, albeit unnamed, in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', a [[2004]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Wikipedia:First-person shooter|first]] and [[Wikipedia:Third-person shooter|third-person shooter]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[Pandemic Studios]] and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="BF1" /> It was later identified in the [[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]], a strategy guide published by [[Prima Games]] in the same year.<ref name="BF1 guide" /> The DC-15x sniper rifle's design is almost identical to the [[E-11s sniper rifle/Legends|E-11s sniper rifle's]] design, with the only difference being a wooden stock.<ref name="BF1" />
